designationHistory.name: Red Rock Lakes Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Red Rock Lakes Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7023 on April 22, 1935.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Red Rock Lakes National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7023, Apr. 22, 1935, Establishing Red Rock Lakes Migratory Waterfowl Refuge

review.note: Draft date 1961 is the year of the rename to Red Rock Lakes NWR, not the establishment. "Roosevelt" in the sentence is Franklin D. Roosevelt.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Roosevelt established the Red Rock Lakes Migratory Waterfowl Refuge, which was renamed the Red Rock Lakes National Wildlife Refuge in 1961.
